label: StackPrep snapshot (trimmed, pinned commit)
notes: Trimmed subset of StackPrep at the pinned commit: interview tool handlers, Inngest jobs (planning, report, code index), shared libraries and the code parser. Tests, the web app and evals/ are excluded.
Headline benchmark corpus. Its numbers are reported separately from the synthetic corpus and never averaged with them.
The snapshot is not HEAD. Refreshing it (scripts/snapshot.ts) is a corpus change that forces re-labelling, re-recording and re-approval.
Only code index rows (code_module, file_summary) and symbols exist; the AI-generated key_files and modules rows of a real analysis are absent.
